    m = instance["num_vars"]
    clauses = instance["clauses"]
    for bits in itertools.product([False, True], repeat=m):

                (bits[abs(lit) - 1] if lit > 0 else not bits[abs(lit) - 1])
                for lit in clause

    edge_set = {frozenset(e) for e in edges}

            s = set(subset)
